# Celestial Reference Origin

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CelestialReferenceOrigin`](gmeow-CelestialReferenceOrigin.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CelestialReferenceOrigin>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The origin of a celestial coordinate system (topocentric, geocentric, barycentric, heliocentric, etc.). A value vocabulary aligned to IVOA refposition.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:CelestialReferenceOrigin`](gmeow-CelestialReferenceOrigin.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to mint or reference the origin of a celestial coordinate system (topocentric, geocentric, barycentric, heliocentric), aligned to IVOA refposition.

### Avoid when

- Avoid encoding the origin as a frame subclass ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Mint the origin as a [`gmeow:CelestialReferenceOrigin`](gmeow-CelestialReferenceOrigin.md) individual and reference it from a celestial frame via [`gmeow:hasReferencePosition`](../properties/gmeow-hasReferencePosition.md).

### Examples

- ex:refOriginHeliocentric a [`gmeow:CelestialReferenceOrigin`](gmeow-CelestialReferenceOrigin.md).
